resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a mandatory biometric update because face matches against a different parent Aadhaar could not be determined either way, being neither confirmed as duplicates nor cleared as false positives.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a first-time biometric update, which is de-duplicated like a fresh enrolment and must be cleared of any match to another identity. The evidence for the face matches from another parent was inconclusive, so the packet could not be passed and was rejected. A new packet with a complete, good-quality capture of every modality is needed to make the comparison decisive.
